messages:
Maria K: Heads up — receiving partner hardware shipment for marketplace onboarding is on hold at regional staging (LAX customs) pending paperwork. Affects 12 racks (~48 GPUs) earmarked for next-gen Dedicated pilot.
Lee S: On it, Maria. Do we have manifests? Partner name?
Maria K: Partner = Northforge Cloud. Manifest IDs: NF-2026-0331-A / NF-2026-0331-B. ETA for clearance unknown. They attached a declaration doc.
Sophie L: I pinged the broker. They say missing ATA carnet info. Broker expects docs in 4-6 hrs if partner sends.
Jordan P: If clearance slips beyond 24h we need to reallocate capacity. Which reservations depend on this batch?
Raj M: Two Dedicated customers on boarding next week (AcmeHealth, Shoply). Both on trial reserved capacity. Can't delay them much.
Lee S: Let's triage: 1) Ask partner for carnet now. 2) Ask supplier to split shipment so critical racks can be expedited. 3) Start contingency plan.
Maria K: I already asked partner; they're pushing paperwork but asked for clear escalation path.
Lee S: I'm drafting email to partner ops + customs contact. Copying broker:
```
To: customs@northforge
Subject: URGENT - ATA carnet needed NF-2026-0331
Please provide scanned carnet and commercial invoice for manifests A/B within 2 hours to avoid detention fees.
```
Jordan P: In parallel, ops runbook step: if more than 12h delay, reassign 24 GPUs from non-critical pool -> mark as 'soft-reserve' for AcmeHealth/Shoply.
Sophie L: Cost hit estimate if we split/airfreight = +$7k per rack. We need approval.
Raj M: I can ask AcmeHealth to accept a partial onboarding (24 GPUs) this week and remainder next week. Shoply needs full stack — may need credit or SLA exception.
Maria K: @Raj M please confirm acceptance window by EOD. @Lee S please escalate to partner account AM.
Lee S: Escalation sent. Partner replied: 'We will escalate with customs and send carnet within 3 hrs.'
Jordan P: Update: provisional reassignments in config: `dedicated_pool: soft_reserve=[AcmeHealth:24G, Shoply:24G]` — will hold for 18h then revert.
Sophie L: Broker confirmed hold reason and expects docs in 2.5 hrs. If not received we'll trigger split/shipment.
Maria K: Action items: Maria -> monitor and update channel; Lee -> confirm partner docs; Jordan -> prep reassign; Sophie -> cost calc + vendor quote; Raj -> customer comms.
Raj M: I'll send messaging drafts to customers and ops for approval.
deploy-bot: Reminder: update the partner-onboarding runbook: /runbooks/marketplace-onboarding if new step added.
Maria K: Thanks team. Please post any docs here. I'll flag if we need to invoke credit/compensation policy. :crossed_fingers:
